blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **си́льный** — strong, powerful. Source: Wiktionary, «-ный» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ный#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**сильнее** — си́льный: strong, powerful; (grammar) irregular. Wiktionary: си́ла + -ный.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **ви́дный** — visible, conspicuous. Source: Wiktionary, «-ный» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ный#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**видна** — ви́дный: visible, conspicuous; outstanding, eminent, prominent; stately, portly. Wiktionary: вид + -ный.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **слы́шный** — audible (able to be heard). Source: Wiktionary, «-ный» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ный#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: наро́дный — people's; у́мный — clever, smart, intelligent; ча́стный — private; ве́рный — true, faithful, loyal.
**слышны** — слы́шный: audible (able to be heard). Wiktionary: слы́шать + -ный.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **наро́дный** — people's. Source: Wiktionary, «-ный» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ный#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**народный** — наро́дный: people's; popular; popular, folk, vernacular; national. Wiktionary: наро́д + -ный.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **у́мный** — clever, smart, intelligent. Source: Wiktionary, «-ный» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ный#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**умен** — у́мный: clever, smart, intelligent. Wiktionary: ум + -ный.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: тру́дный — hard, difficult; зву́чный — resounding, sonorous; нау́чный — scientific; поря́дочный — decent, honest, respectable.
